description: ClearExams current-affairs notes for 27 October 2026: eight verified developments across science, economy, environment, governance, international relations, defence and tribal affairs, with twelve original exam-style MCQs.

stories.title: Prime Minister inaugurates ESTIC 2026 in New Delhi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The three-day conclave, scheduled for 27–29 October, brings government science departments, researchers, startups and industry together to connect research with practical technologies. Its theme is “Creative Minds, Catalyzing Science, Empowering Technologies.”
key_facts: ESTIC 2026 was inaugurated on 27 October 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The conclave runs from 27 to 29 October 2026.
The 2026 edition is organised by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research and involves multiple science-related ministries and departments.
Its theme is “Creative Minds, Catalyzing Science, Empowering Technologies.”
stories.exam_link: Connect ESTIC with India’s science-policy ecosystem: CSIR functions under the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, while the Principal Scientific Adviser coordinates cross-sector scientific advice to the Union Government.
stories.source_title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi inaugurates Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026

stories.title: DPIIT launches National Startup Awards 6.0
stories.summary: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade launched the sixth National Startup Awards under Startup India. Applications opened on 27 October and close on 20 November 2026. The edition covers 20 sectoral and three special categories, introduces 12 new sectors and adds a Student Innovator/Aspiring Entrepreneur Award; the announcement is a call for applications, not the declaration of winners.
key_facts: National Startup Awards 6.0 has 20 sectoral categories and three special categories.
The application window is 27 October–20 November 2026.
The special categories include Women-Led Startup of the Year, North-East Startup Excellence and Student Innovator/Aspiring Entrepreneur Award.
Winning startups in eligible startup categories can receive ₹25 lakh per category; the student award has a total ₹25 lakh pool across four sub-categories.
DPIIT administers Startup India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
stories.exam_link: Revise Startup India, launched in January 2016, and DPIIT’s role in startup recognition, intellectual-property support, ease of doing business and industrial policy.
stories.source_title: DPIIT Launches 6th Edition of National Startup Awards to Recognise Innovation and Entrepreneurship

stories.title: India presents biodiversity position at CBD COP17
stories.summary: At the high-level segment of the Convention on Biological Diversity’s COP17 in Yerevan, India reaffirmed support for the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework while stressing national circumstances, predictable finance, capacity-building and technology transfer. India also backed benefit-sharing from digital sequence information through the multilateral mechanism, including the Cali Fund, and called for a science-based, risk-proportionate approach to synthetic biology and biosafety.
key_facts: CBD COP17 is being held in Yerevan, Armenia.
India’s updated National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan translates the global framework into 23 national targets and 142 indicators.
India supported benefit-sharing from digital sequence information on genetic resources through the multilateral mechanism, including the Cali Fund.
The Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework was adopted under the Convention on Biological Diversity.
stories.exam_link: Link the CBD with its three objectives—conservation, sustainable use and fair benefit-sharing—and with India’s Biological Diversity Act, National Biodiversity Authority and national biodiversity action planning.
stories.source_title: India Reaffirms Commitment to Biodiversity Conservation and Effective Implementation of Global Biodiversity Framework at CBD COP-17 at Yerevan, Armenia

stories.title: India and Netherlands deepen trade and investment engagement
stories.summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal held government, parliamentary and business engagements in the Netherlands focused on trade, investment, market access and technology partnerships. An India–Netherlands Business Forum brought together about 200 participants, and a separate roundtable involved executives from 15 Dutch companies. These were cooperation discussions and business engagements rather than a newly signed bilateral treaty.
key_facts: The engagements took place during the minister’s Netherlands visit and were reported on 27 October 2026.
The India–Netherlands Business Forum had approximately 200 participants.
A CXO roundtable included representatives of 15 Dutch companies.
The Netherlands was described as an important gateway to European markets.
stories.exam_link: Revise India–Netherlands relations through trade, ports and logistics, water management, agriculture, green transition and technology; the Netherlands is a European Union member and Rotterdam is Europe’s largest seaport.
stories.source_title: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal Holds High-Level Engagements in the Netherlands to Strengthen Bilateral Trade and Investment Ties

stories.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concludes with joint declaration
stories.summary: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi after meetings on 26–27 October 2026 and adopted a joint declaration under the people-centric development theme. The forum is an inter-parliamentary platform: its declaration records political consensus and cooperation priorities, but it is not a domestic law or a binding international treaty.
key_facts: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum was held in New Delhi on 26–27 October 2026.
The forum concluded with adoption of a joint declaration.
The declaration’s theme was “Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development.”
The parliamentary forum complements, but is institutionally distinct from, the BRICS leaders’ summit.
stories.exam_link: Compare parliamentary diplomacy with executive diplomacy: Parliament scrutinises policy and represents citizens, while treaty-making and formal foreign relations are principally executive functions under India’s constitutional system.
stories.source_title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Concludes in New Delhi, with Adoption of a Joint Declaration

stories.title: SIMBEX 2026 concludes at Visakhapatnam and in Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: The 33rd Singapore–India Maritime Bilateral Exercise concluded on 26 October and was reported by the Defence Ministry on 27 October. Hosted by the Indian Navy at Visakhapatnam, it had harbour and sea phases. The sea phase in the Bay of Bengal covered maritime interdiction, anti-submarine, anti-air and anti-surface warfare, seamanship and cross-deck flying to improve interoperability.
key_facts: SIMBEX 2026 was the 33rd edition of the bilateral naval exercise.
The participating services were the Indian Navy and the Republic of Singapore Navy.
Singapore deployed RSS Supreme, while India deployed INS Nilgiri and INS Kamorta with aviation assets.
The exercise’s two phases were the Harbour Phase and Sea Phase.
stories.exam_link: Place SIMBEX within India’s maritime diplomacy in the Indian Ocean Region and revise the difference between bilateral exercises, multilateral exercises and coordinated patrols.
stories.source_title: Conclusion of 33rd Edition of Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026)

stories.title: Concessional annual local pass notified for nearby highway users
stories.summary: The Union Government introduced a concessional local pass for eligible non-commercial vehicle owners living within 20 km of a National Highway fee plaza. Effective 1 November 2026, it costs ₹1,500 annually at plazas outside municipal or local-town limits and ₹3,000 within those limits. Eligibility requires a valid FASTag; the pass is tied to one plaza and excludes closed-system tolling and locations with an available service or alternative road.
key_facts: The residence criterion is within 20 km of the relevant fee plaza.
The annual rates are ₹1,500 outside municipal or local-town areas and ₹3,000 within them.
The rule takes effect on 1 November 2026; availability through the Rajmargyatra app begins on 1 December 2026.
The change was notified through the National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026 under the National Highways Act, 1956.
The pass is plaza-specific and non-transferable.
stories.exam_link: Revise the National Highways Act, 1956, FASTag-based electronic toll collection and the distinction between open tolling, where users pay at a plaza, and closed tolling, where charges reflect entry and exit points.
stories.source_title: Government of India Introduces Concessional Local Pass for National Highway Users Living Near Fee Plazas

stories.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Pakhwada planned for 1–15 November
stories.summary: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs announced that Janjatiya Gaurav Pakhwada will be observed nationwide from 1 to 15 November 2026, culminating in Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas on Birsa Munda’s birth anniversary. The programme is a future plan, not a completed event: the ministry listed more than 300 projects, two national digital launches and over 160 state-level activities to support outreach and last-mile delivery of tribal schemes.
key_facts: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas is observed on 15 November, the birth anniversary of Birsa Munda.
The Government of India designated the day in 2021.
The 2026 Pakhwada is scheduled from 1 to 15 November.
Planned activities include an EMRS student interaction, a tribal literary festival and programmes for tribal women entrepreneurs and traditional healers.
PM-JANMAN focuses on Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
stories.exam_link: Connect Birsa Munda’s Ulgulan movement with tribal resistance to colonial land and forest policies, and revise Article 46, the Fifth and Sixth Schedules and PVTG-focused welfare programmes.
stories.source_title: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas 2026: Nationwide Tribal Pride Celebration from Nov 1 to 15

mcqs.question: ESTIC 2026 was inaugurated at which venue?
mcqs.explanation: The Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026 was inaugurated at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 27 October 2026.

mcqs.question: Which Union department launched National Startup Awards 6.0?
options: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
mcqs.explanation: DPIIT, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, launched the sixth edition under the Startup India initiative.

mcqs.question: How many sectoral categories are included in National Startup Awards 6.0?
mcqs.explanation: NSA 6.0 contains 20 sectoral categories and three special categories, including a new student award.

mcqs.question: CBD COP17, where India presented its national statement, is being held in which city?
mcqs.explanation: The seventeenth Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity is being held in Yerevan, Armenia.

mcqs.question: India’s updated biodiversity action plan translates the global framework into how many national targets?
mcqs.explanation: India stated that its updated National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan contains 23 national biodiversity targets and 142 indicators.

mcqs.question: The India–Netherlands Business Forum reported on 27 October 2026 had approximately how many participants?
mcqs.explanation: The official release said approximately 200 Indian and Dutch government and business representatives attended the forum.

mcqs.question: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded with which outcome?
mcqs.explanation: The New Delhi meeting concluded with adoption of a joint declaration; it did not create a treaty-based currency, alliance or customs union.

mcqs.question: SIMBEX is a bilateral maritime exercise between India and which country?
mcqs.explanation: SIMBEX is the Singapore–India Maritime Bilateral Exercise involving the Indian Navy and Republic of Singapore Navy.

mcqs.question: Which pair correctly represents Indian Navy ships that participated in SIMBEX 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Defence Ministry listed the stealth frigate INS Nilgiri and anti-submarine warfare corvette INS Kamorta among India’s participating assets.

mcqs.question: What is the residence-distance limit for the new concessional local highway pass?
mcqs.explanation: Eligible non-commercial vehicle owners must reside within 20 km of the relevant National Highway fee plaza.

mcqs.question: What is the annual concessional pass fee at an eligible plaza outside municipal or local-town limits?
mcqs.explanation: The notified annual fee is ₹1,500 outside municipal or local-town limits and ₹3,000 within those limits.

mcqs.question: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas is observed on the birth anniversary of whom?
mcqs.explanation: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas is observed on 15 November, the birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter Birsa Munda.
